issues.issue: Did the officer breach procedural fairness by not giving the applicant an adequate chance to respond to misrepresentation concerns?
issues.applicant_position: Officer asked about raw poultry grading she never did, then cut the interview short without letting her respond.
issues.result_quote: The Officer did not provide the Applicant with an adequate opportunity to respond to concerns of misrepresentation, and as a result, the Applicant was not afforded due procedural fairness.
